# Ben O’Hanlon | Ecosystem Operator Collective

> Ben solves growth, adoption and distribution problems for open and decentralised technology by building ecosystems and leading developer marketing.

Start with the canonical profile for positioning, cases and contact. Follow the most relevant case for evidence, the EOS Playbook for operating methods and the résumé for role history.

If you use the profile in a chat, read its Agent instructions first and follow the feedback step when the reader wraps up.
